column1: Marcus made excellent progress across all developmental domains in fall 2025.
Social-Emotional: Strong. He is kind to peers, confident in sharing his ideas, and increasingly able to wait his turn and follow multi-step directions.
Language and Literacy: Above expectations. His vocabulary is rich, he uses descriptive language naturally, and he shows early reading readiness with strong letter-sound awareness.
Math: At or above expectations. Counting is solid to 15 with 1:1 correspondence; patterning is strong; beginning comparisons of size and number.
Fine Motor: Developing appropriately. Scissor use improving; pencil grip and drawing detail showing clear growth from September.
Areas for continued growth: Transitioning between preferred and non-preferred activities; tolerating incomplete projects without frustration.
Recommendation for next semester: Continue Pre-K in Room 4; introduce kindergarten readiness writing activities; continue enriching his dinosaur interest as a motivation anchor.
Teacher Signature: Ms. Tanisha Warren, Lead Teacher, Room 4
